en.intro: This SanDisk 128GB microSDXC card carries an official license for the Nintendo Switch, Switch OLED and Switch Lite, giving you up to 128GB of extra space for downloaded games, screenshots and video captures. Our concierge checked the model, variant, stock and price before listing; after you order, FeelBetter buys it from the seller in the United States and ships it to Korea, typically in 7–14 business days.
highlights: The card is officially licensed for the Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch OLED and Nintendo Switch Lite systems.
With read speeds of up to 100MB/s and write speeds of up to 90MB/s, you spend less time waiting and more time playing.
You can instantly add up to 128GB of storage to your system.
Your downloaded games, screenshots and video captures stay in one place, so you can travel light.
It is a UHS-I, Class 10 microSDXC card in the Super Mario Super Mushroom Edition design.

sections.p: This card is made for the Nintendo Switch, Switch OLED and Switch Lite. It is not designed for the Nintendo Switch 2, for which the listing recommends a separate SanDisk microSD Express card, so please choose another card if you own that console.

The card is a 128 GB microSDXC UHS-I, Class 10 model (SDSQXAO-128G-GNCZN) and measures about 0.4 x 0.6 inches (1.0 x 1.5 cm). The speeds of up to 100MB/s read and 90MB/s write are based on internal testing noted in the listing, so real results can be lower depending on the device and conditions.

cautions: Not compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2; it is made for the Switch, Switch OLED and Switch Lite.
The listed capacity counts 1GB as 1,000,000,000 bytes, so the storage you can actually use is less.
